articles.title: Mockup Catalog Authoring
articles.summary: Admin-build editor that turns a corporate-catalog custom-logo product into a managed mockup workflow — pick the variation axes, attach a reference photo per combination, and write the managed catalog without touching YAML.

advanced.title: Admin build only
advanced.text: This editor is compiled only into the admin build, and the backend additionally requires an active dashboard administrator session. An installation key on its own can never reach the authoring endpoints.

Open the Product Mockup Studio, then use the Add button beside the product search. The first screen lists every custom-logo product in the corporate catalog with its SKU, category, and the variation facets that product already publishes. Products that already have a mockup workflow are marked Configured and open for editing rather than creating a duplicate.
Choosing a product opens the editor. The left rail is the setup: identity, colors and scenes, then placements. The main panel is the reference grid — one cell per combination of the enabled axes.

advanced.title: Describe each thing exactly once
advanced.text: Every layer owns one prompt and they are combined at generation time, each labelled with the option it came from. Write the scene on the scene, the color on the color, the location on the placement, and leave the product prompt for what is true of every render. You never repeat a scene description across colors.

rows: Click a scene option in the rail
Every color rendered in that scene
Click a color option in the rail
Every scene rendered in that color
Every reference, for that logo location

advanced.text: An option with a prompt shows a small dot on its chip, and each axis header counts how many of its options carry one. Adding a scene repeats the colors inside it and carries the photos you have already uploaded across the new combinations, so nothing is lost; removing an axis collapses them back. An axis can be deleted outright with the bin icon on its card.

advanced.title: The grid is meant to be sparse
advanced.text: A cell with no reference photo is simply not offered in the studio. That is normal, not an error — the shipped Venture Towel publishes 11 sources across a 2x6 grid because there is no golf-course photo of the white towel.

Drop an image straight onto a cell, or select the cell and use Upload to store it in the managed reference directory. Uploads are named after the combination (studio-black.png) under the product's own folder. A per-cell prompt is optional and marked with a dot on the cell; use it when one colour or scene needs an instruction the product prompt cannot express.

The product prompt at the bottom is the main instruction and must be at least 20 characters. Describe what to preserve from the reference photo and how the imprint should look. Everything above it — the axes, the grid, the placements — only decides which reference image a given selection resolves to.

advanced.title: Saving is live, and validated first
advanced.text: Every committed change is saved automatically once the draft is valid. The backend re-validates the whole document through the studio's own catalog loader before writing, so a rejected draft leaves the live catalog untouched. The studio re-reads the managed document on every request, so a successful save is visible immediately with no restart.
Each authored product also records the corporate-catalog SKU and id it came from, so a mockup workflow and its catalog product can be correlated later without guessing from the title.
